question: The God of Small Things is a novel authored by whom among the following authors?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy** is the author of the critically acclaimed novel **The God of Small Things**, which won the **Booker Prize** in **1997**.
 
• This novel is her **debut work** and is widely regarded as a masterpiece of contemporary literature.
 
• The book is set in the Indian state of **Kerala** and explores themes such as **family, social discrimination, love, and tragedy**.
 
• Roy's writing style is characterized by **lyrical prose and a non-linear narrative structure**, which has been highly praised by critics.
 
• Arundhati Roy is not only a novelist but also a prominent **activist and essayist**, known for her outspoken views on social and environmental issues.
 
• Her other notable works include **The Ministry of Utmost Happiness** and several collections of essays such as **Capitalism: A Ghost Story**.
 
• The success of **The God of Small Things** brought global recognition to Roy, making her one of the most celebrated Indian authors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fakira**__

 __
 
• **Fakira** is a novel written by **R.V. Deshpande**, a renowned Marathi author.
 
• This novel is not related to **The God of Small Things** and primarily deals with the **issues of social reform** in rural India.
 
 
 
• **Rohinton Mistry**__
 __
 
• **Rohinton Mistry** is a celebrated Indian-born Canadian author known for works like **Such a Long Journey** and **A Fine Balance**.
 
• Although his novels also explore complex social themes, he did not write **The God of Small Things**.
 
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor**__
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor** is an Indian politician, diplomat, and writer known for books like **The Great Indian Novel** and **Inglorious Empire**.
 
• Tharoor's works often focus on **Indian history, culture, and politics**, but he is not the author of **The God of Small Things**.
